en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neo‑Romanian villa with arcaded loggias, stairways with balustrades and a square belvedere tower, set in landscaped grounds. The back is printed in Romanian and Russian and bears a green 38‑bani stamp of the Romanian People's Republic with Bucharest postal cancellations dated 1953; it is addressed to an addressee in Bucharest and mentions Mamaia.
